'''R2-B1''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]]. His last assigned duty was on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], in the repair droid pool on the royal cruiser belonging to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]]. There the droid worked alongside the famed [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="Insider's Guide" />

==Biography==
During the blockade of Naboo and the subsequent heroic escape, the ship carrying Queen Amidala was hit by enemy fire and damaged. The six droids stored on board were sent out to repair the damage during the attack. R2-B1 was one of the many droids destroyed in this event, blasted off the hull of the starship. Only R2-D2 survived to restore shield power to the cruiser, allowing the ship to eventually make its way to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for further repairs.<ref name="SW1" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TAC_r2b1.jpg|200px|thumb|left|R2-B1 action figure]]
After appearing briefly in {{Film|I}}, this droid was first named in the ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]'' CD-ROM Glossary section.<ref name="Insider's Guide" />

The [[Hasbro]] toy company produced three distinct action figures portraying R2-B1. The first was issued in the year [[2000]], in the [[Star Wars: Episode I (toy line)|Episode I toy line]],<ref name="2000 figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#51: R2-B1 (Astromech Droid)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TAC51R2B1.asp}}</ref> the second in [[2007]] as part of [[Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|''30th Anniversary Collection'']].<ref name="2007 figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#51: R2-B1 (Astromech Droid)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TAC51R2B1.asp}}</ref> The last iteration was included in the [[2012]] "Royal Starship Droids" four-figure "Battle Pack", part of the Walmart exclusive ''[[Star Wars: Movie Heroes|'Discover the Force']]'' series.<ref name="2012 figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Movie Heroes|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=Royal Starship Droids|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Royal_Starship_Droids.asp}}</ref>

For [[May 4|Star Wars Day]] [[2015]], Gamestop released an exclusive Funko POP! R2-B1 Vinyl Bobble-Head figure.
